claims.claim: RAN2 asks RAN4 to check measurement reporting for configured candidate secondary cells even when deactivated.
claims.passage:
1. Overall Description:
During the discussion on LTM SCell activation, RAN2 understands the UE can send L1 measurement report for LTM candidate SCells as in the LTM configuration, whether the candidate happens to be a deactivated SCell or not has not impact on this. 
RAN2 would like to check whether it is OK with RAN4. 
2. Actions:
To RAN WG 4:
RAN2 kindly request RAN4 to take the above information into account during the future work, and provide feedback, if any.

claims.claim: The request concerns secondary-cell activation during LTM under Release 20 mobility enhancements Phase 5.
claims.passage:
Title:	LS on deactivated SCell measurement report in SCell activation during LTM
Response to:	-
Release:	Rel-20
Work Item:	NR_Mob_Ph5
Source:	RAN2
To:	RAN4
As part of Rel-18, enhanced mobility feature: Layer1/Layer2 Triggered Mobility (LTM) was introduced with the aim of reducing interruption time and latency from handovers due to mobility.

claims.claim: RAN2 understands that UE measurement reporting for LTM candidate secondary cells follows the configuration regardless of deactivation.
claims.passage:

claims.claim: RAN2 requests RAN4 feedback for future work; the liaison does not establish RAN4 agreement.

claims.claim: RAN2 asks RAN1 and RAN4 to confirm reuse of relevant Release 18 and 19 LTM UE capabilities.
claims.passage:
The highlighted agreements above are relevant to RAN1/RAN4, as these agreements assume reuse of the relevant R18/R19 LTM UE capabilities defined by RAN1/RAN4. In addition, the candidate cell scope under these capabilities is extended to include both LTM candidate SpCell and LTM candidate SCell. For these reasons, RAN2 considers it necessary to align with RAN1/RAN4 regarding such reuse.
2. Actions:
To RAN WG 1 and WG 4:
RAN2 kindly request RAN1 and RAN4 to confirm the reuse of the relevant R18/R19 LTM UE capabilities as stated in the RAN2 agreements, and provide feedback if there is any concern.

claims.claim: RAN2 extends the candidate-cell scope to both candidate special cells and candidate secondary cells and identifies this as a reason for alignment on reuse.
